routes.name: BOC documented salary / current-account purchase and wire
routes.who: Overseas individual with lawful mainland current-account RMB income
routes.mechanism: Buy FX against ID and transaction-value source materials, then remit through BOC.
routes.limit: No stated annual ceiling in Article 59 for qualifying overseas-individual current-account income; bank authenticity review applies.
routes.documents: ID; employment/source documents; tax evidence unless nontaxable; payment purpose; beneficiary details.
routes.tax_cn: Income tax attaches to the underlying income, not to moving already-taxed principal. Personal tax is blank.
routes.tax_us: US worldwide income/reporting may apply; moving principal is not a second income event by itself. Personal tax is blank.
pros: No generic USD 50,000 ceiling for qualifying Article 59 income
cons: FX quote and receiving fees unknown

routes.name: Standard Chartered China documented current-account electronic transfer
routes.who: SC China customer with qualifying lawful current-account income
routes.mechanism: SC electronic overseas transfer; tier and OUR selection affect sender-side tariff.
routes.limit: Provider electronic-banking limits and regulatory source review apply; account-specific limit not verified.
routes.documents: ID; source/tax evidence; SC eligibility and beneficiary details.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax is separate; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules separate; personal tax blank.
cons: OUR does not guarantee every beneficiary-side deduction

routes.name: Wise CNY salary outflow to own overseas account
routes.who: Non-mainland individual with qualifying China work/tax records
routes.mechanism: Wise CNY sending channel to an account the sender owns abroad.
routes.limit: Current help: CNY 300,000 per China-bank-app transfer; CNY 50,000 via Alipay; overall limit depends on documented income/tax.
routes.documents: China work/tax records within three years; own overseas account; provider verification.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying salary tax separate; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules separate; personal tax blank.

routes.name: Repeat salary purchase at the same bank
routes.who: Foreign employee with a valid employment contract and prior approved salary purchase
routes.mechanism: Repeat lawful salary purchase at the same bank may avoid repeated duplicate materials.
routes.limit: Same underlying Article 59 income rule; facilitation is procedural, not a new quota.
routes.documents: First-time salary/source/tax file; valid contract; repeat payment evidence.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying salary tax separate; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules separate; personal tax blank.
pros: Uses the same lawful income basis

routes.name: Nontaxable lawful current-account income
routes.who: Overseas individual whose mainland current-account income is nontaxable under the rules
routes.mechanism: Purchase/remit with ID and transaction-value source materials; tax voucher may be omitted if nontaxable.
routes.limit: No tax voucher where the income is nontaxable under the rules; bank still reviews source.
routes.documents: ID; source materials; basis for nontaxable treatment.
routes.tax_cn: Nontaxable status must be established; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US tax may still apply; personal tax blank.
pros: Avoids assuming a Chinese tax voucher is always required
cons: Nontaxable in China does not mean nontaxable in the US

routes.name: Registered foreign equity-incentive sale/dividend proceeds
routes.who: Foreign employee participating in a registered mainland-listed equity incentive plan
routes.mechanism: Remit or convert registered plan proceeds through the bank against registration and broker evidence.
routes.limit: Only qualifying registered plan proceeds; not a generic securities/savings channel.
routes.documents: Plan registration certificate; matching ID; broker/trading evidence; bank authenticity review.
routes.tax_cn: Plan income may have IIT obligations; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US worldwide income and asset reporting may apply; personal tax blank.

routes.name: Basic pension / retirement pay under uniform state provisions
routes.who: Person receiving qualifying basic pension/retirement pay
routes.mechanism: Document the lawful income and ask the bank for the applicable current-account purchase/remittance treatment.
routes.limit: No numeric personal limit verified; underlying pension exemption is narrow.
routes.documents: Pension entitlement/source evidence; ID; tax treatment evidence; bank checklist.
routes.tax_cn: Basic pension/retirement pay under uniform state provisions is exempt under the IIT law; other retirement income is not automatically exempt.
routes.tax_us: US taxation/reporting of pension income is separate; personal tax blank.
cons: Bank FX path and fees not verified

routes.name: Genuine business / trade current-account payment
routes.who: Registered business with a real cross-border transaction
routes.mechanism: Pay a genuine service/goods obligation through the business’s FX/current-account process.
routes.limit: Real lawful transaction required; no personal savings ceiling verified.
routes.documents: Contracts; invoices; tax/filing evidence where covered; business registration; bank review.
routes.tax_cn: Business taxes depend on the transaction; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US entity/owner reporting may apply; personal tax blank.
pros: Can be scalable for real trade
cons: Not a wrapper for personal savings

routes.name: Nonresident house-sale proceeds
routes.who: Nonresident seller of mainland property with completed transfer/tax steps
routes.mechanism: Remit documented sale proceeds after transfer registration and tax steps.
routes.limit: Transaction-specific; no generic savings limit. External-payment filing described above USD 50,000 where covered.
routes.documents: ID; transfer contract/registration; tax voucher; filing form where required; agent POA if used.
routes.tax_cn: Property-transfer gain may be taxed; personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US gain/reporting rules separate; personal tax blank.
cons: Local practice and inherited cases need confirmation

routes.name: Emigrant property transfer
routes.who: Person with qualifying pre-emigration mainland property and former household registration
routes.mechanism: Apply to former-hukou SAFE office; after approval bank remits directly to applicant’s own overseas account.
routes.limit: Within approval; 2014 circular allows lump sum or batches. Old staged schedule not confirmed current.
routes.documents: ID; emigration/former-hukou evidence; title/source; tax evidence; application; agent POA if used.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying asset taxes may apply; transfer itself is not a generic income tax. Personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US gain/reporting rules separate; personal tax blank.

routes.name: Inheritance property transfer
routes.who: Qualifying foreign/HK/Macao/Taiwan heir of mainland estate
routes.mechanism: Apply at decedent’s former-hukou SAFE office; bank remits directly to applicant’s own overseas account.
routes.limit: Within approval; different decedents may be combined at one competent office under the 2026 FAQ.
routes.documents: ID; inheritance proof; decedent title/source; tax evidence; application; agent POA if used.
routes.tax_cn: No blanket inheritance-tax rate is asserted; underlying asset taxes may apply. Personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: Foreign inheritance above USD 100,000 may require Form 3520; income later produced is separate. Personal tax blank.
cons: Not a gift or savings workaround

routes.name: Corporate dividend / profit distribution to foreign shareholder
routes.who: Foreign shareholder of a compliant mainland enterprise with distributable profit
routes.mechanism: Distribute genuine profit through the enterprise’s bank/tax process.
routes.limit: Real profit and corporate approvals required; no personal savings limit verified.
routes.documents: Board/partner distribution resolution; financial/tax evidence; shareholder ID; bank review.
routes.tax_cn: Enterprise and withholding taxes depend on facts; personal/corporate tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US shareholder reporting/income rules separate; tax blank.

routes.name: Liquidation residual of a foreign-invested enterprise
routes.who: Foreign investor in a lawfully terminated/liquidated enterprise
routes.mechanism: Remit residual value after liquidation and tax payment under the FX Regulation.
routes.limit: Liquidation-specific; no generic personal limit verified.
routes.documents: Liquidation/tax/title evidence; investor ID; bank/SAFE checklist.
routes.tax_cn: Liquidation taxes depend on facts; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US shareholder reporting/income rules separate; tax blank.

routes.name: Capital reduction / equity transfer / ODI-style capital route
routes.who: Person or entity with a genuine approved capital transaction
routes.mechanism: Potentially available only under the specific capital-account rules and approvals.
routes.limit: Not verified for this fact pattern; no limit populated.
routes.documents: Transaction approvals, registration, tax and source evidence would be required.
routes.tax_cn: Not verified; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: Not verified; tax blank.
cons: Cannot be used to relabel savings

routes.name: Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect southbound
routes.who: Eligible Greater Bay Area mainland investor
routes.mechanism: Paired dedicated RMB/CIPS accounts invest in eligible HK/Macao products; proceeds return to mainland remittance account.
routes.limit: Closed-loop and quota management; not a US repatriation account.
routes.documents: GBA eligibility; paired dedicated accounts; product suitability; bank quota.
routes.tax_cn: Investment income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules may apply; tax blank.

routes.name: QDII product / custody channel
routes.who: Investor in an approved QDII product
routes.mechanism: Institution invests under SAFE quota; redemption/dividend FX may return to domestic individual FX accounts under the rules.
routes.limit: Institutional quota and product terms; no personal offshore cash entitlement.
routes.documents: Product subscription; institution quota/custody; redemption terms.
routes.tax_cn: Investment income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules may apply; tax blank.
pros: Can hold foreign assets through a product

routes.name: Stock Connect southbound trading link
routes.who: Eligible mainland investor under current Stock Connect rules
routes.mechanism: Closed-loop trading link; RMB between mainland broker and ChinaClear, HKD at HK side.
routes.limit: Current eligibility/quota not verified; historical operator presentation only.
routes.documents: Broker eligibility; current scheme rules; account docs.
routes.tax_cn: Investment income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting/income rules may apply; tax blank.

routes.name: Convert to USD and hold in a mainland FX account
routes.who: Person permitted to purchase/retain FX under the applicable source rule
routes.mechanism: Purchase FX and retain it in the person’s own domestic FX account where the underlying rule permits.
routes.limit: Depends on the underlying current/capital permission; no standalone exit quota.
routes.documents: ID; source/tax evidence; bank account rules.
routes.tax_cn: No tax merely from holding principal is asserted; FX gain rules may apply. Personal tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US FBAR/8938 and FX-gain rules may apply; personal tax blank.
pros: Official destination option for current-account purchased FX
cons: Does not solve capital-account source problem

routes.name: Carry foreign cash within the no-permit tier
routes.who: Traveller carrying up to USD 5,000 equivalent without a controlling prior entry declaration
routes.mechanism: Carry cash out and report to US customs if covered instruments exceed USD 10,000 on entry/exit.
routes.limit: Up to USD 5,000 equivalent without carry permit under the cited notice; frequent-traveller rules differ.
routes.documents: Travel documents; customs declarations where required; source evidence.
routes.tax_cn: No conversion tax asserted; underlying income tax separate. Tax blank.
routes.tax_us: CBP reporting above USD 10,000 is not a tax; personal tax blank.
cons: Grid amounts above tier are not feasible as a single carry

routes.name: Carry foreign cash above USD 5,000 through USD 10,000 with bank permit
routes.who: Traveller in the bank-permit cash tier
routes.mechanism: Obtain bank carry permit and declare where required.
routes.limit: Above USD 5,000 through USD 10,000 equivalent needs bank permit under the cited notice.
routes.documents: Bank permit; travel documents; source evidence; customs declarations.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: CBP reporting is separate; tax blank.
cons: BOC carrying certificate fee waived through 2026 but other costs unknown

routes.name: Carry foreign cash above USD 10,000 with exceptional SAFE approval
routes.who: Exceptional traveller meeting the notice’s special conditions
routes.mechanism: SAFE carry permit for exceptional cases; not a routine large-transfer channel.
routes.limit: Above USD 10,000 is exceptional and needs SAFE approval under the cited notice.
routes.documents: SAFE application; travel/source evidence; permit; customs declarations.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: CBP reporting is separate; tax blank.
cons: Grid amounts are not approved by this page

routes.name: Overseas ATM withdrawal with mainland bank cards
routes.who: Cardholder using ordinary overseas ATM withdrawals
routes.mechanism: Withdraw cash abroad within per-person annual and per-card daily aggregation limits.
routes.limit: CNY 100,000 per person per calendar year across cards; CNY 10,000 per card per day.
routes.documents: Card; travel/ATM evidence; bank limits.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting may apply; tax blank.
cons: ATM operator fees and card FX unknown
Borrowing cards to evade is prohibited

routes.name: Ordinary overseas card spending
routes.who: Cardholder making genuine personal overseas purchases
routes.mechanism: Spend directly abroad; distinct from ATM cash withdrawal aggregation.
routes.limit: Ordinary spending is not the ATM cash-withdrawal quota; provider limits apply.
routes.documents: Card; merchant transactions; provider terms.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting may apply; tax blank.

routes.name: BOC clean collection / draft instruments
routes.who: Customer using a qualifying financial instrument
routes.mechanism: Collection or draft service under BOC personal tariff; instrument and destination rules apply.
routes.limit: Instrument-specific; no generic repatriation limit verified.
routes.documents: Financial instrument; ID; source/purpose evidence; postage if any.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting may apply; tax blank.
cons: Not a verified USD salary path

routes.name: Splitting transfers to evade quota/authenticity review
routes.who: Anyone using multiple persons/cards/accounts to evade controls
routes.mechanism: Do not use. SAFE guidelines and ATM rules prohibit splitting/borrowing cards to evade limits.
routes.limit: Prohibited evasion; no lawful limit populated.
routes.documents: None recommended.
routes.tax_cn: Penalty exposure is separate from conversion cost; personal penalty blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting obligations remain; tax blank.
pros: Named so it is not mistaken for a loophole

routes.name: Underground bank / private FX dealing
routes.who: Anyone offering off-bank CNY/USD swapping
routes.mechanism: Do not use. Private or disguised FX dealing is prohibited.
routes.limit: No lawful limit populated.
routes.documents: None recommended.
routes.tax_cn: Statutory penalty exposure; personal penalty blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting obligations remain; tax blank.

routes.name: CNY–crypto–USD bridge
routes.who: Anyone attempting fiat/virtual-currency exchange to move value
routes.mechanism: Do not use. Mainland fiat/virtual-currency exchange and related business are prohibited illegal financial activity.
routes.limit: No lawful limit populated.
routes.documents: None recommended.
routes.tax_cn: 2026 No.42 replaces 2021 No.237; personal penalty blank.
routes.tax_us: US digital-asset reporting/tax may apply; tax blank.

routes.name: False trade / salary / inheritance documents
routes.who: Anyone misrepresenting the source or purpose
routes.mechanism: Do not use. Current-account payments require a real lawful transaction basis.
routes.limit: No lawful limit populated.
routes.documents: None recommended.
routes.tax_cn: Deceptive transfer penalty exposure; personal penalty blank.
routes.tax_us: US reporting obligations remain; tax blank.

routes.name: Borrowing another person’s quota or account
routes.who: Anyone using a third party to evade personal limits
routes.mechanism: Do not use. Splitting and third-party evasion are prohibited; property transfers require own-account destination.
routes.limit: No lawful limit populated.
routes.documents: None recommended.
routes.tax_cn: Penalty exposure; personal penalty blank.
routes.tax_us: US gift/reporting rules may apply to real gifts; tax blank.

routes.name: Unverified fintech / offshore RMB workaround
routes.who: Person offered a provider or offshore conversion scheme
routes.mechanism: No verified lawful personal route or price retrieved for this fact pattern.
routes.limit: No limit populated.
routes.documents: Provider licence, regulatory basis and account-specific terms would be required.
routes.tax_cn: Not verified; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: Not verified; tax blank.

routes.name: QDLP / private-bank structured repatriation programme
routes.who: Investor offered a private programme
routes.mechanism: No verified general personal repatriation entitlement or price retrieved.
routes.limit: No limit populated.
routes.documents: Programme approval, eligibility and product terms would be required.
routes.tax_cn: Not verified; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: Not verified; tax blank.

routes.name: Domestic-individual convenience quota if the bank classifies the person as domestic
routes.who: Person the bank classifies as a domestic individual under the applicable rules
routes.mechanism: Use the annual convenience purchase quota only if the classification actually applies.
routes.limit: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year convenience quota for domestic individuals; classification conflict flagged.
routes.documents: ID; bank classification; source/purpose evidence above quota.
routes.tax_cn: Underlying income tax separate; tax blank.
routes.tax_us: US worldwide reporting remains; tax blank.
cons: A US passport usually points away from this classification
